description: This file defines the PHP class 'BuzzPost' which represents a social media post or a similar entity within the OrangeHRM HRM system. It includes properties such as 'id', 'employee', 'text', timestamps, and related photos and links, along with getter and setter methods.

classes.name: BuzzPost
classes.description: Entity class representing a social media post within the OrangeHRM system, including properties for content, creator, timestamps, and related media.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the post.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the post.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Retrieves the Employee who created the post.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Associates an Employee with this post.

methods.name: getText
methods.description: Returns the text content of the post.

methods.name: setText
methods.description: Sets the text content of the post.

methods.name: getCreatedAtUtc
methods.description: Returns the creation timestamp in UTC.

methods.name: setCreatedAtUtc
methods.description: Sets the creation timestamp to the current UTC time.

methods.name: getUpdatedAtUtc
methods.description: Returns the last updated timestamp in UTC.

methods.name: setUpdatedAtUtc
methods.description: Updates the timestamp to the current UTC time.
